build_lexicon_graph: build a graph that transduces letters to word pieces using a lexicon and letter-to-index mapping
build_token_graph: build a graph with individual token transition models for consuming one or more consecutive word pieces
compose_word_decomposition: compose an input graph with a lexicon graph and project output to compute word decompositions
compute_alignment_graph: compute the alignment graph by composing token graph with decomposition graph and projecting input
calculate_sequence_loss: calculate sequence-level loss by subtracting forward scores of intersected emissions and alignment graphs
